hints.title: Vector Space Representation
hints.text: Model integers as binary vectors over GF(2) with vector addition equivalent to bitwise exclusive-or.

hints.title: Linear Basis Insertion
hints.text: Insert each number into a linear basis of size 32 using Gaussian elimination.

hints.title: Greedy Bit Maximization
hints.text: Traverse basis vectors from most significant to least significant bit, toggling whenever the running total increases.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Linear basis construction in O(N * 32) time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining 2^N possible subsequences is impossible for large N.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Basis table requires only 32 integer entries.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize the linear basis pattern for maximum XOR subsequence.
